errors.text_span: в по-късните слоеве (напр. около 19–23) са видими комбинации от оранжеви, зелени и червени сегменти с различни височини
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect generalization. In the 'Text' plot for layers 19-23, no single bar contains a combination of orange, green, and red segments. Layer 19 has orange and red; Layer 21 has orange and blue; Layer 23 has green and red.

errors.text_span: а слоеве 11, 13 и 15 са изцяло червени (Expert 4)
errors.evidence: In the 'Image' plot, layer 15 is not entirely red (Expert 4). It has a small blue segment (Expert 1) and an orange segment (Expert 2) at the bottom.

errors.text_span: при слой 17 има малък син сегмент в основата и основно червен сегмент до 100%
errors.evidence: In the 'Image' plot, the bar for layer 17 is composed of an orange segment (Expert 2) and a red segment (Expert 4), each making up about 50% of the bar. There is no blue segment (Expert 1).

errors.text_span: in diesen Farben von unten nach oben gestapelt
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars are stacked from bottom to top in the order of the colors mentioned (blue, orange, green, red), which implies a fixed stacking order. The figure shows that the stacking order of colors varies between bars. For example, in the 'Text' plot, bar 1 is stacked blue-orange, but bar 3 is stacked orange-green.

For the 'Text' plot, the bar at index 3 is composed of approximately 20% orange (Expert 2) at the bottom and 80% green (Expert 3) at the top. The description incorrectly states the top 80% is blue (Expert 1).

errors.text_span: bei 9, 11 und 13 überwiegend rot (je ca. 75–85 %) mit einem orangefarbenen Rest
errors.evidence: This description is correct for bars 9 and 11, but incorrect for bar 13 in the 'Text' plot. Bar 13 is composed of approximately 20% orange (Expert 2) and 80% green (Expert 3), not red (Expert 4).

errors.text_span: bei 17 ungefähr halb blau und halb rot
errors.evidence: For the 'Image' plot, the bar at index 17 is composed of approximately 50% orange (Expert 2) at the bottom and 50% red (Expert 4) at the top. The description incorrectly states the bottom half is blue (Expert 1).
